name: Almhof Family Resort & SPA
beschreibung: The Almhof Family Resort & SPA is a family-oriented hotel in Gerlos, Tirol. It is located near the valley station of the Dorfbahn, which leads into the Zillertal Arena ski area. The accommodation offers family rooms and apartments. The wellness area includes an indoor pool, a whirlpool, and several saunas. For children, there is an indoor play area, a petting zoo, and a supervised program. Meals are provided on a half-board basis, consisting of a breakfast buffet and dinner. A shuttle service is available for trips to the lift facilities. The offering combines sports activities with opportunities for relaxation.
